description.narrative: Project-level impact includes (i) increased access to quality housing for middle income populations; and (ii) environmental effects via improved efficiency in energy and water usage as a result of EDGE certification for properties identified under this Project. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates the investment to promote competitiveness in the Indian housing sector by providing i) competitive pressures on developers already operating in the target micro-markets to improve the price and quality of their projects and (ii) demonstration effects to other developers that will be incentivized to expand in smaller micro-markets, adapt their business model to achieve economies of scale and cater to middle-income populations.

The proposed investment involves IFC investment of up to INR 4,250 million (US$50 million equivalent) in wholly owned subsidiaries of TVS Emerald Limited (TVS Emerald or the Company), including Emerald Haven Life Spaces 2 Private Limited (previously known as Radial (Phase II) IT Park Private Limited), Emerald Haven Life Spaces 3 Private Limited (previously known as Radial (Phase III) IT Park Private Limited) and Emerald Haven Properties Private Limited for part financing development of middle-income housing projects in India (the Project). The first project is located on the Pallavaram-Thoraipakkam Radial Road, Chennai and the second project is located in Sathanur, Bengaluru. Other middle-income housing projects will be located in Chennai and Bengaluru and will be jointly identified by the Company and IFC. The housing projects will be green building certified and are expected to include development of 4,000 5,000 housing units.
